Refactored `./report` package to improve readability while preserving identical observable behavior. Applied mechanical lint fixes replacing `WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(...))` with `fmt.Fprintf`, and flattened nested conditionals using early returns and guard clauses. Net: -2 lines.

## Deleted

No dead code found.

| Location | Before | After | Why |

| `report.go:23` | `b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(...))` | `fmt.Fprintf(&b, ...)` | Mechanical lint fix (staticcheck QF1012) |
| `report.go:31,33` | `b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(...))` | `fmt.Fprintf(&b, ...)` | Mechanical lint fix (staticcheck QF1012) |
| `report.go:44,46` | `b.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(...))` | `fmt.Fprintf(&b, ...)` | Mechanical lint fix (staticcheck QF1012) |
| `report.go:26-41` | 4-level nested conditionals | Flat validation-first loop | Guard clauses reduce nesting, improve readability |

## Modernization

- Go directive: 1.27 (unchanged)
- Toolchain: go1.27.1
- `go fix` did nothing; all changes were manual
- Adopted `fmt.Fprintf` over `WriteString(fmt.Sprintf(...))` (stdlib best practice)

## Behavior risk

None. All changes preserve exact error messages, output format, and control flow. Validation order unchanged (empty account checked before negative units).

```
                 baseline    after
gofmt            pass        pass
build            pass        pass
vet              pass        pass
test             pass        pass   (no test files)
race             pass        pass
lint findings    3           0
diff             — empty —
```
